description: Prepare a private AUDIO (audio/mpeg, audio/mp4, audio/ogg, audio/wav; ≤ 50 MiB) or FILE attachment (PDF, DOCX, XLSX, CSV, TXT; ≤ 25 MiB) upload for a writable page of this job. Returns a ONE-TIME signed PUT upload URL exactly once per idempotency key: PUT the bytes there yourself with exactly upload.contentType — this tool NEVER carries file bytes and the URL is never persisted or replayed — then call asset_finalize (server-side byte sniff + size bound) and insert the returned schema-v2 node (instructionAudio / instructionAttachment) on the page. A duplicate key returns the non-secret receipt with recovery guidance (cancel, then re-prepare under a NEW key).

contentType.description: Must belong to the chosen kind’s set (enforced per kind).

kind.description: audio: audio/mpeg, audio/mp4, audio/ogg, audio/wav up to 52428800 bytes; file: application/pdf, application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document, application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet, text/csv, text/plain up to 26214400 bytes.

sizeBytes.description: audio ≤ 52428800 bytes, file ≤ 26214400 bytes (enforced per kind).

name: opentrain_job_instructions_asset_prepare
